name: file-input
title: File Input
description: Materialize file field: a raised button and a read-only path field listing the selected files, with drag and drop.
improvements: The real input[type=file] stays focusable (visually hidden, not an invisible overlay), so Tab, Enter and Space work and the button shows a focus ring.
The button and label name the file input; helper and error text are linked with aria-describedby.
Drag and drop files onto the field, filtered by accept and multiple.
The path field follows form resets and an optional clear button, and onFilesChange reports the File objects.
